main_body: A flat wall face (sci-fi/metal panel wall) with an orange rail band, recessed panels and a base strip; drawn straight-on as a vertical wall, with no top surface.
top_band: none (rows 0-4 are a steel-blue header band; the orange rail at row 5-6 is a vertical trim band, not a horizontal surface)
evidence: The kind is terrain (wall face tile), so a wall face drawn as a flat vertical front view is the expected form. The column scan shows an outline row, a header band, an orange rail, then panel faces and a base, all vertical faces. Panels are inset with dark inner edges. There is no horizontal top surface, which is acceptable for a wall-face terrain tile, but strictly by the contract it reads as a front elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 14 distinct colours against 68 and 33 for the references, and a median of 9 colours per tile against 26 and 13 for the references. Its 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 7% where both references have 0%. Panels, base strip and header are large flat blue-grey areas with only a few rivet dots and short highlight dashes. The outline is tinted (0% neutral dark edge pixels), so it is not a sticker line. There are only about 4 lightness steps per material against the references' 5-6. Overall it is thinner and flatter than the references.
